question: Naurata' dance during Navratri is performed in which region?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bundelkhand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Naurata dance** is a significant folk dance tradition performed exclusively in the **Bundelkhand** region, which spans across parts of **Madhya Pradesh** and **Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• It is performed by **unmarried girls** during the **nine days** of the **Navratri** festival, which typically falls in the months of **September** or **October**.
 
• The primary objective of this ritualistic dance is to seek the blessings of the **Goddess** for attaining a **good husband** and a **prosperous married life**.
 
• During the performance, girls create intricate **mural paintings** known as **Naurata** on the walls of their houses using **lime**, **clay**, **cow dung**, and **vibrant colors**.
 
• The dance involves rhythmic movements around these symbolic representations, often accompanied by traditional folk songs that narrate religious stories or local legends. <stro
